name: Tardigrub
ability: Cryptobiosis (its own: once per battle, a hit that would knock it out leaves it at 1 HP) / Water Veil / Shell Armor (hidden)
look: a plump glossy teal tardigrade with a segmented back, a red mouth ring in a black X on its blunt face and four pairs of stubby legs
entry: It lives in damp moss and puddles. When the water dries up it curls into a husk and waits, for years if it must; a single drop of rain brings it back to life.
how: Wild: common in swamps, rivers and lakes, and in lush caves.
Evolves into Aristograd at level 35, learning Grub Volley.
